title: Deeper/broader peer security, generated ACIS carrier, and consumer-scope refresh
mode: primary-source research and local source/test reconciliation
scope: Refresh LibreDWG LTYPE, FIELD, and unaligned-access reports against normative DXF rules and local code/tests
Reconcile ACadSharp repeated-record stack exhaustion reports with existing generated hardening coverage
Refine the optional scratch-generated ACIS carrier gate and FreeCAD consumer qualification boundary

method.kind: Read upstream issue/documentation pages and inspect local source/test ownership
method.limitations: Issue reports are reporter-authored and version-specific. LibreDWG #1411's public ezdxf recipe was not executed; no current peer build or native FreeCAD/kernel runtime was qualified. FreeCAD documentation establishes published scope only. Local code/test conclusions are source inspection, not newly executed test results.

sources.revision: Issue bodies retrieved 2026-10-18; mutable issue state
sources.observed: #1450 reports an AC1024 LTYPE code-9 text field without group 74 and a peer bounds failure; #1451 reports FIELD group 93=0 with a primary ACFD_FIELD_VALUE and a peer use-after-free; #1452 reports a UBSan misaligned BITCODE_RS access through a packed C structure in the peer EED encoder.

sources.project: Autodesk DXF LTYPE and FIELD references
sources.observed: The LTYPE table defines group 74 flags and restricts group-9 text to text elements; FIELD group 93 identifies data-set count. The LTYPE reduced peer shape is malformed as a valid-file witness under that contract.

sources.revision: Issue body retrieved 2026-10-18; mutable issue state
sources.observed: The report describes stack exhaustion from repeated comments, XDATA application blocks, and clipping-group records. Peer counts and runtime behavior are not normative format thresholds. Existing local generated controls cover 20,000 comment records, repeated XDATA in ASCII/Binary, malformed clipping counts in ASCII/Binary, and a following LINE sentinel.

sources.project: LibreDWG issue #1411 and scratch producer reference
sources.observed: The issue reports a 5,489-byte mesh-derived SAB in an AC1032 DXF REGION and payload loss through LibreDWG 0.14.8593 DXF-to-DWG-to-DXF. The recipe is a potential locally generated scratch carrier test, not a reproduced current result or shape-semantic oracle.

sources.revision: Published documentation reviewed 2026-10-18; repository marked archived
sources.observed: The import/export matrix describes DWG/DXF support as 2D geometry; the Draft DXF guide says the stock importer does not read embedded ACIS/SAT blobs. This is published scope, not runtime qualification.

existingPlanGatesRefined: FIELD zero-child primary-value and following-object boundary evidence
Optional S8 generated ACIS carrier provenance and non-promotion boundary
FreeCAD qualification limited to pinned 2D/projection consumer outcomes
assessment.planImpact: Avoid duplicate LTYPE/FIELD and stress controls already present. Keep the LibreDWG #1452 alignment report as a source-shape mismatch. If S8 carrier provenance needs an added observation, generate the public SAB cube only in disposable scratch and measure carrier/association separately from semantics. Use FreeCAD only as a pinned 2D/projection consumer, not an ACIS/AcDs semantic gate.

workingTree.reason: The shared worktree already contains broad user/work-in-progress changes; only the requested plan and this receipt were changed.
